desc: a relay that never answers (an address that drops every packet, as behind a firewall or a dead uplink): hosting a room leaves the relay's thread stuck in its connect; Leave returns at once (under a second) instead of freezing the game until the OS gives up on the connect (20 s to 2 minutes). The Aurora build (headless has no WebSocket)
log_must: test: the menu's Host a room
online: relay: .*closed while still connecting, without waiting for its thread
